answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 59 identities per epoch. Audits are published in umber, queued in copper, and cipher publishes the wait time. A farm of 41 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4970 identities would post 4044 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
